items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: The interviewee does not mention John Perhonas; the name is only introduced by the interviewer as the interviewer's own name.

ctx.x: John Perhonas It's all over the back, Sam. Yeah. Mm-hmm. My name is John Perhonas, and I'm from the American Studies Program at the University of Minnesota. Next to me is Dick Allen, Curator of the Jazz Archives at Tulane University. And we are talking of William Russell at his home on Orleans Street in New Orleans. Today is February 16, 1976, George Washington's Birthday. Officially. Officially. We don't know whether it is or not. Anyway, I'd like to ask Bill Russell something about his name, because I think…

It's my first name and second name. I was born and also William Wagner, and then when I began writing music music. Roughly around 1930, we'll say. I changed it as a pen name, just using my middle name and first name then.
